Short title and Commencement

BANK OF PUNJAB (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
BANK OF PUNJAB (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance further to amend the
Bank of Punjab Act, 1989
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 8th May, 1997]
No.Legis‑3(XVIII)/97, dated
8‑5‑1997.‑‑The following Ordinance promulgated by the
Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Bank of
Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the day the Bank of Punjab
(Amendment) Ordinance, 1997 (VII of 1997) stands repealed under Article 128(2)
of the Constitution.

Amendment of section 4 of Act XII of 1989

BANK OF PUNJAB (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
BANK OF PUNJAB (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance further to amend the
Bank of Punjab Act, 1989
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 8th May, 1997]
No.Legis‑3(XVIII)/97, dated
8‑5‑1997.‑‑The following Ordinance promulgated by the
Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 4 of
Act XII of 1989.‑‑I5 the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 (XII of 1989)
in section 4, in subsection (I), for the words "five hundred million
rupees divided into fifty million ordinary shares", the words "one
thousand million rupees divided into one hundred million ordinary shares"
shall be substituted.
